title: Inspect Fonts & Colors (DataAndAutomation)

scenarios.title: Inspect Fonts & Colors applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Inspect Fonts & Colors (BtnPropertyExtraction) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Property report normalization, hex conversion and layout are pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: COLORREF values decode to #RRGGBB with the low byte as red; font names drop blanks then deduplicate and sort, sizes drop non-positive values, colors drop negative values (all deduplicated and sorted); the report line layout is 'Scope:', 'Fonts:', 'Font sizes:' (sizes suffixed ' pt', rendered in the current culture), 'Text colors:', 'Fill colors:', 'Line colors:' with 'None' for empty groups and trailing whitespace trimmed.

scenarios.title: Inspect Fonts and Colors copies the real report to the clipboard in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Inspect Fonts and Colors on one bold text box shows its report plus the YesNo copy confirmation (the driver measures dialogSeen=True and dismisses with a synthetic key press), copies the report to the clipboard (measured clipHasReport=True, the clipboard carries the Fonts and Colors report for the fixture (the report lists font names/colors - e.g. the fixtures Verdana - and does NOT contain the shape text, measured)) and returns true, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.
